favourite.heading: Why Vanderbilt can pull away
bullets: Vanderbilt is the better football team by 5.9 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+5.9 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 4.4 points to Vanderbilt (+4.4 pts).
Playing at Vanderbilt is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Vanderbilt by 2.0 points: ball control vs front disruption (+2.0 pts).

underdog.heading: Why NC State can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -6.6 to p90 +37.4 for Vanderbilt, so a projection of +16.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
